name: cache-keeper
description: Context, quota and prompt-cache meters above the prompt; while the session is idle on a 1-hour cache, keeps it alive and compacts before it lapses, holding off system sleep meanwhile (Linux, Windows, macOS).

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL and related variables, the promptCacheTtl setting, then 1 hour on a subscription) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it. The keeper only runs on a 1-hour cache.

marginMinutes.title: Act before expiry (minutes)
marginMinutes.description: How long before the cache lapses the keep-alive or compact runs.

keepAlives.title: Keep-alives before compact
keepAlives.description: How many times an idle session's cache is refreshed before the session is compacted (0 compacts at the first deadline).

keeper.title: Keep-alive and compact
keeper.description: Run the keep-alive and compact while idle. Off leaves the meters alone.

inhibitSleep.title: Hold off system sleep
inhibitSleep.description: While a keep-alive or compact is pending, block idle sleep (systemd-inhibit, SetThreadExecutionState or caffeinate).

band.title: Meters above the prompt
band.description: Two rows above the prompt: context and quota, then cache and keeper.

quota.title: Quota in the band
quota.description: Show the 5-hour and 7-day plan windows in the band.

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Also pin a short entry under the prompt.
